subject: MAP readiness roundup — acceptance decisions & blockers
message_1_body:
Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is aligned to move forward with a limited POC focused on chat latency and hallucination rate for our knowledge base. We talked internally and want to lock a weekly cadence for MAP checkpoints so we can track acceptance criteria and unblockers.

High level asks from our side: 
- Acceptance thresholds: less than 200ms median token latency and hallucination rate < 2% on our eval set.
- Delivery: 2-week POC, weekly MAP check-ins, final acceptance test on week 3.

Can you confirm owners for: evaluation plan, environment setup (VPC/peering), and roll-forward criteria if thresholds aren’t met? Also please attach the latest eval plan and any network checklist we should be aware of.

Best,
Priya
Priya Desai
Head of Platform Engineering, ACME Corporation
message_2_subject: Re: POC timeline and MAP cadence
message_2_body:
Hi Priya — thanks, and excited to run this with ACME.

Quick summary and proposed owners: 
- Evaluation plan (metrics and datasets): Marissa Cole (marissa_cole) — attached redwood-eval-plan-v2.xlsx.
- Environment & networking (VPC peering): Laura Bennett (laura_bennett) will coordinate with your SRE and provide a checklist; we’ve attached a VPC peering notes PDF.
- Roll-forward / fallback policy: Rishi Malhotra (rishi_malhotra) will own canary-to-fallback configurations and a fallback to a smaller model variant if latency or hallucinations spike.

MAP weekly checkpoint proposal (30 min): 
- Cadence: Thursdays 10:00 AM PT starting 2027-06-15 
- Agenda: status (5m), acceptance metric review (10m), blockers & mitigations (10m), actions & owners (5m)

Action items I’m assigning now: 
1) Marissa to finalize eval split and push sample injection scripts (owner: marissa_cole) — due 2027-06-14.
2) Laura to confirm VPC peering window with ACME (owner: laura_bennett) — target complete by 2027-06-13.
3) Rishi to prepare fallback model config and SLO thresholds (owner: rishi_malhotra) — draft by 2027-06-14.

Attachments: redwood-eval-plan-v2.xlsx (evaluation matrices), vpc-peering-checklist.pdf (network pre-reqs).

If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and a short MAP doc for the shared drive.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
message_3_subject: Re: POC timeline and MAP cadence — eval plan updates
message_3_body:
Karthik / Priya — taking point on the eval plan. Quick notes from my side: 
- I trimmed the eval set to three buckets: KB-faq (10k tokens), KB-longform (5k tokens), and adversarial prompts (2k).
- Acceptance checks: hallucination measured via entity-level precision against ground truth; will provide a CSV with per-test thresholds.
- Smoke test: I’ll push a sample injection script to the shared drive and a small token-limited run so we’re not burning quota on early tuning.

Open question for ACME: do you have a preferred sampling of user prompts (recent week vs historical)? If you can drop a small corpus link we’ll incorporate it.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Applied ML — Evals, Redwood Inference
message_4_subject: Re: POC timeline and MAP cadence — VPC peering window
message_4_body:
On Tue, Jun 15, 2027 at 11:03 AM Redwood Inference wrote:
> Quick summary and proposed owners: 
> - Environment & networking (VPC peering): Laura Bennett (laura_bennett) will coordinate with your SRE and provide a checklist; we’ve attached a VPC peering notes PDF.

Thanks — Laura. Two items from our side that could block the Thursday cadence if not resolved: 
1) Peering approvals: our security team requires a scheduled change window (30–60 min) and a brief ACL review — earliest slot we have is 2027-06-18 02:00–03:00 UTC.
2) IP allowlist: we need the exact egress IPs your dedicated pool will use; can you confirm by EOD 2027-06-16?

If those two items aren’t ready we’ll only be able to run the evals inside a fenced staging environment, which is fine for functional metrics but won’t capture latency under representative network conditions.

- ACME SRE
message_5_subject: Final MAP runbook + Thursday 10AM PT check-in (confirmed)
message_5_body:
Team — quick update and decisions following Laura’s note: 

Decisions and adjusted plan: 
- Thursday 2027-06-18 10:00 AM PT standup is confirmed as the weekly MAP checkpoint (30 min). Agenda will follow the proposed cadence.
- Since ACME’s peering approval window lands on 2027-06-18 02:00–03:00 UTC we’ll run two evaluation passes: 
  a) Staging pass (network-constrained) on 2027-06-16 to validate correctness (Marissa leads).
  b) Production-network pass after peering is complete on 2027-06-18 (latency numbers will be authoritative).
- IP allowlist: Laura will share the egress IPs by EOD 2027-06-16 (owner: laura_bennett).
- Fallback: If latency > 250ms median on official pass, Rishi will enable model-fallback config and notify ACME SRE; acceptance will be re-run after fallback stabilization.

Action items (owner — due):
- Marissa: push sample injections and baseline run to Drive (marissa_cole) — due 2027-06-16.
- Laura: share egress IPs & confirm peering window (laura_bennett) — due 2027-06-16.
- Rishi: publish fallback config + SLO docs to MAP doc (rishi_malhotra) — due 2027-06-17.
- Priya / ACME: provide user prompt corpus or a link to a safe subset (Priya Desai) — due 2027-06-15 (if not possible we’ll use the historical sample).

I’ll upload a one-page runbook to the shared Drive and send the calendar invite for Thursday. If any owner cannot meet the due dates reply here so we can reassign.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
